lean.statement: theorem formalFunctions_finite_quotient_iso_b {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (y : Y) (p : ℕ) : let X' := pullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let f' := pullback.fst (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f let F' := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F let J := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv.hom)).comap f' let C := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X'.toRingedSpace p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).inv ≫ f'.appTop).hom ∃ b : formalCompletionSystem J F' ⋙ C ≅ formalFibreCohomologySystem f y F p ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))), ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p), (b.hom.app (op n)) ((C.map (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F')) z) = formalFunctionsFinitePullback f y F p n z
